utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — I’m running a bit late, but I can still help with whatever’s left. What do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — could you take a look at the sign-in table and help direct folks as they arrive? If you’ve got time after that, we could also sort the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo—could you bring a flashlight, a small wrench set, and some gloves? If you already have them, that would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a flashlight, a small wrench set, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what supplies we’ve got for the repair drive. Tell me what you still need, and I’ll help track it down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I think we still need a few tools and some extra tape. I might be forgetting something, though.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep track of the tools and extra tape, and we can fill in the rest as it comes to mind.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad the repair drive is happening. If you need a hand sorting supplies, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey. I might take you up on that once I check the list and figure out what still needs to be packed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just send me the list when you’re ready, and I’ll help pack what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell — are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina — I think so, but I’m still hearing second-hand details. Can you remind me what time and what I should bring?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yep — it’s Saturday at 10 in the community lot. Just bring your tools if you have them, plus gloves and anything you’d like fixed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks are dropping off all kinds of things. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great to hear—happy to lend a hand if they need any extra tools or repairs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s awfully kind of you, Gus—I’ll pass that along. If I hear they need anything specific, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive — it’s going to be a great neighborhood turnout. I’ll make sure you’re on the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — please put me on the list. If you know the drop-off location and time, send it my way too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the drop-off location and time as soon as I have it. Glad you’re coming!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm whether you’re able to collect donations or just help with the setup?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with both, but I’m especially good for setup if you need me there early.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help organize the repair drive, Bo. What do you want me to coordinate first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the tool list and volunteer sign-ups, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll draft the tool list and set up volunteer sign-ups. If you have any must-have tools or preferred times, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring it up and repeat the repair drive plan to the others.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Keep it simple and clear, and let me know if you need me to pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep it simple and repeat the repair drive plan to everyone. I’ll let you know if I need you to pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit forgetful, but I’m happy to help; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. If you could help check the tools and carry a few boxes, that would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, I can do that—just point me to the tools and boxes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I’m just trying to spread the word while I’m out running errands. If you can point me to a few people who might need help or want to volunteer, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can ask around and point you to a few folks who could use help or pitch in. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you should come by the repair drive—everyone’s welcome, and I’m telling the whole block about it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll swing by if I can make it. Let me know what time things get started.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll spread the word and text you the start time as soon as I know it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is this weekend—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m not sure yet, but I’d like a clear list before I head over. If you hear what they need, tell me and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything. A clear list would help me too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times if that makes the repair drive easier. What timing are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, thank you. I’m thinking early evening after pickup, maybe around 5:30, so folks can swing by once they’re done with school runs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 5:30 sounds doable for me, and I can help spread the word around pickup. Do you want me to ask a few parents if they can pitch in then?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — could you tell folks we’re collecting broken small appliances and bikes this Saturday, and ask them to drop by between 10 and 2?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll tell people we’re collecting broken small appliances and bikes this Saturday, and that they can drop by between 10 and 2.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’ll make a quick list so we don’t forget anything and then I’ll let you know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Pia — I’ll be ready when you’ve got the list. Happy to help out however I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where the repair drive is happening—just tell me the location and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — let’s note it as the community center parking lot on Pine Street. I’ll send the time details next.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve noted the community center parking lot on Pine Street. I’ll wait for the time details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the details first, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll look into the repair drive status and tell you as soon as I have something solid.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — just let me know when you’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you bring a couple of hammers, some screwdrivers, and any spare nails or screws you’ve got? If you’re free, helping sort the donations would be a big help too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll bring hammers, screwdrivers, and whatever nails and screws I can find, and I can help sort donations too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m happy to help if you need a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Nell — that’d be great. I’m still trying to keep track of what’s changed, so I may need a little help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — just point me to the latest update, and I’ll do my best to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The repair drive is still happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still going on — I’d check the community board for the latest drop-off times and what they’re still collecting.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — I’ll check the community board. Just to confirm, the drop-off times may have changed, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive is getting moving — what do you need me to keep an eye out for while I’m out?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: If you spot any spare tools or donated lumber, that’d help a lot. And please keep an eye out for anyone willing to lend a hand—quietly, if you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll keep it quiet and look for tools, lumber, and anyone who seems willing to help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, I’m a bit scattered today. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring the basic tools if you’ve got them, and we can sort the rest there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll bring my basic tools and head over. If I forget anything, you can point me to the nearest thing that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure you can help with that? What kind of repair drive is it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — I can help. Just tell me what needs fixing and where to bring it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the logistics—do we know where the drop-off is and what time they’re taking repairs? If you want, I can help sort out the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Pia — I don’t know the drop-off yet, but I’d love your help sorting it out. If you can check the time and location, I’ll pass it along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Absolutely — I’ll check the drop-off location and timing, then let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Mara — I’m getting the repair drive organized and we can make this smooth for everyone. Tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — let’s start with the broken front gate and the loose sidewalk board by the mailboxes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ll put the front gate and sidewalk board at the top of the list and line up help for both.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the repair drive, and what time should I bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, still on — and I think bringing the tools around 10 would be great. If I remember the exact spot, I’ll let you know!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there with the tools at 10. Just send me the exact spot when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep asking around too, and we can compare notes once we hear something.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll check in with a few folks while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep things low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Totally understood — low-key works. I’ll spread the word gently and keep your name out of it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is happening soon—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m not sure yet, but I can check the list and let you know. I like having the plan clear before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great—I’m mostly hearing bits and pieces. If you find out what they still need, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my tool box and help set up a table for folks to drop off repairs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll handle the sign and get a table ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t seen the details yet—what exactly needs repair, and when is the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late to the details too, but I can help check what’s still needed. Do you know if they’ve set a date yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet — I’m going to check for the date and the list of repairs before I act.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — I’m at the community center if you want to compare notes and make a list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m on my way over now so we can compare notes and make that list together.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive details first. What time are they coming by?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, sorry, I’m missing the details too. I’ll check on the time and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah—send it when you have it, and I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Sam — the repair drive’s coming up soon, and I’m telling everyone in the block. You should come by; it’ll be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks for telling me, Quinn — I’ll come by and help out if I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Sam — I really appreciate it. I’ll put you down and we’ll make sure there’s plenty to do.
